name: 99th Oscars 2027
job: Help viewers track Academy milestones and understand a time-zone-label discrepancy without presenting unannounced nominees or winners as fact.
source_notes: Academy lists ceremony 14 March 2027 and nominations announcement 21 January. May release says 7pm ET/4pm PT while April release calls the same wall times EST/PST; 14 March is a US daylight-saving transition date under current time-zone data. Treat absolute instant as needing confirmation.
